summary.name: Devin Desktop
summary.one_liner: Devin Desktop is the renamed Windsurf IDE, rebuilt as a command center for managing multiple AI coding agents locally or in the cloud.
use_cases: coordinating multiple coding agents on long tasks
running agent sessions locally or in the cloud
managing agent work via kanban view
upgrading from Windsurf to a new IDE
summary.what_it_does: The page describes Devin Desktop as the new name for Windsurf, built on the Windsurf IDE foundation with an Agent Command Center (Spaces, Kanban view, multi-agent management). It says users can manage agents, including through the Agent Client Protocol (ACP), from one place, and run sessions on their own machine or in Devin Cloud with the same context. Devin can coordinate subagents, each producing its own pull requests. The page also lists features such as Fast Context for locating files, Devin Review for diffs, Devin Fusion (a lead model paired with a cheaper executing model), and Supercomplete for next-thought prediction. It lists integrations with Slack, Linear, Notion, Jira/Confluence, Datadog, Sentry, Figma, Vercel, and Stripe, plus language servers for Rust, C/C++, Python, and Go.
notable: Agent Command Center with Spaces, Kanban view, and multi-agent management
Devin Cloud sessions that can move between local machine and cloud with shared context
Agent Client Protocol (ACP) support for managing multiple agents and models
Rebrand of Windsurf; existing plans, extensions and settings carry over
caveats: Pricing is not stated on the page; the page says existing Windsurf plans and pricing are unchanged
Multi-agent support is described as a research preview (per a customer quote)
Windsurf for JetBrains continues to be available as a separate download
